title: 4권 스토리북 · sb4_map
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. One single continuous picture: never split it into panels, frames or a collage, and draw each character only once. No humans or human children anywhere in the picture; every creature is an animal (Fairy E is the only fairy). Full-page picture-book illustration. None of the characters from the attached sheet appear in this picture. Scene: A hand-drawn storybook map of the Magic Castle drawn like a cutaway seen from the side: at the bottom the forest path and the big round gate, then a courtyard with a small lake and a cave; a hedge garden with tall pine trees; a great stone hall with stairs; a blue-tiled bathroom and a sand-dune room; a round riddle room; a toy room with a train track; a tower room with a tree and a window over the sea; a broken bridge over a moat; a rooftop garden with a little couch; and the tallest tower's dark top room with a round window. Small dotted paths link the rooms. No letters or text anywhere.
